      "diagnosis": "Workflow 2 has flawed or underspecified rules for completion-event determination and output eligibility in streaming/session-style problems: it likely (a) infers job completion from inactivity/session closure, or (b) relies on an explicit terminal event when the task requires inactivity-gap logic for stages, and/or (c) allows emitting intermediate/incomplete aggregates or emitting for all keys seen instead of only eligible completed jobs.",
